name: Kashima Mifu
source:
First year student at Chihaya High, [url=/c7875]Neo[/url]'s younger sister. She can't walk so she's confined to a wheelchair. Has a gentle and cheerful personality, likes flowers and poetry.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/You_that_became_a_Memory_~Memories_Off~]Wikipedia[/url] and partly translated from the [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/omokimi/chara.html]Official Site[/url].]
